blocks.heading: Means Being the Lawyer for One Company

items.text: The same study found fewer than 40 percent of companies had a general counsel with a seat at the executive team or board, so the top post is not always a strategy seat.
Corporate India spent an estimated Rs 69,000 to 72,000 crore on legal matters in FY26, up from about Rs 60,000 crore the year before, according to Mint's earlier reporting.

figures.label: Survey Response Share
figures.source: The first work to shrink is the work freshers used to do: document review, diligence data entry and first-draft research. In December 2025 Mint reported that Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas said over 80 percent of its headcount used AI and that it aimed for 90 percent or more. Firms told Mint that time on research and documentation fell by 20 to 30 percent, and by 40 to 60 percent in some document-heavy work ( Mint, 29 December 2025 ).
